Innovation and Enterprise

We work with businesses, researchers, and students to enable new ideas, innovation, and growth.

Our innovation community

We welcome and support innovative people and organisations who want to create the enterprises of the future.

Innovation: For businesses

We can support your business through access to expertise, innovation and funding.

Innovation: For researchers

We can support you to apply your research to launch innovative new enterprises and partnerships.

Innovation: For students

Enterprise Bath can help you achieve your entrepreneurial ambitions and support you on your enterprising journey whilst at university.

Our innovation spaces

Our enterprise spaces provide the environments where enterprising minds can be nurtured and inspired.

University of Bath Innovation Centre

Offering work space, business acceleration, enterprise activities, and network access for high-growth companies and the entrepreneurs that create them.

Enterprise Lab

Our Enterprise Lab is an innovation space where researchers and students can meet and access support to develop their entrepreneurial ideas.

Engine Shed Members' Lounge

University of Bath staff, SETsquared Bath companies, and visitors can use the Engine Shed Members' Lounge, free of charge for meetings.

Our research centres and institutes

We have a range of multidisciplinary research centres and institutes which work in partnership with external organisations, including:

  • Institute for Advanced Automotive Propulsion Systems (IAAPS)
  • Institute for Digital Security and Behaviour
  • Institute for Sustainability and Climate Change
  • Institute for the Augmented Human
  • Institute of Coding
  • Innovation Centre for Applied Sustainable Technologies (iCAST)
  • Centre for the Analysis of Motion, Entertainment Research and Applications (CAMERA)

More on our research centres and research institutes.

News

Our latest innovation and enterprise news.

Innovation with Impact: Reflections from a recent visit to the Department of Chemistry

See the blog post from Dr Jon Hunt, Executive Director of Innovation and Enterprise, on his visit to the Department of Chemistry, with the Vice-Chancellor.

The soft tech that responds to your taps and squeezes

HydroHaptics – a responsive new tech that allows you to dim lights by squeezing a cushion or sculpt on a screen by pinching a mouse – is being developed at Bath

University of Bath awarded multiple ICURe grants from Innovate UK for research commercialisation

Innovation to Commercialisation of University Research (ICURe) supports best new ideas from UK research for investment-ready spinouts and license agreements.

Accelerated Knowledge Transfer funding for short term collaborations with businesses

Accelerated Knowledge Transfer (AKT) funding from Innovate UK is open until 2 July. See successful examples of University of Bath AKTs from the last round.

Strong SETsquared spin-out investment promises to drive regional economic growth

Spinouts from the SETsquared Partnership universities of Bath, Bristol, Cardiff, Exeter, Southampton and Surrey raised an impressive £273m investment in 2024.

Student startup makes University of Bath graduate a millionaire

Lux Rewards loyalty scheme acquired at an eight-figure valuation

Our AI expertise

Hear from academics at the University of Bath on their expertise in AI and Machine Learning and from industry partners on benefit of collaborating with us to help advance their capabilities in AI.

Enterprise Day

We welcome and support innovative people and organisations who want to create the enterprises of the future.

Our goal is to build and sustain a regional entrepreneurial ecosystem which inspires and supports our staff, students, graduates, and local entrepreneurs.

We aim to foster a vibrant, innovative culture with access to programmes, expertise and support to develop entrepreneurial talent.
